name: The Twenty Views of the European Palaces of the Yuanming Yuan
summary: The European Pavilions (Xiyanglou) located in the Yuanming Yuan, or Summer Palace, in Beijing were the grandest expressions of the Qing rulers' interest in the arts of Europe.
